EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your service and support of patients
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name],
Allow me to personally thank you for your service. Your blood drive collected [drive’s collected units] units, and that means more life, more love, more memories for the most vulnerable patients in our community—those suffering unexpected trauma and chronic illness every day. It was a pleasure to partner with you and your colleagues, and we’re so happy to have you in our American Red Cross family.
Since donation is the only source of lifesaving blood for patients, and few organizations can provide the impact that [Company Name] can, we hope you’ll enjoy the pride of your efforts and join us again. The need for blood is ongoing and we can’t sustain patients in need without partners like you.
To discuss [maximizing your upcoming drive] [building your annual blood program] [any feedback about your recent drive], please don’t hesitate to contact me. We honor your service and support of patients by always seeking ways to improve the experience and we value your feedback.
Thank you again, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Sincerely,
[Insert Name]
